# Roger Paulino

Roger Paulino is a visual artist working between printmaking and painting. Born in Pretoria in 1986, he lives and works in Leipzig, Germany.

## Exhibitions
- OFF FIELD (Kunstpunkt Berlin, Berlin, 10 - 26 Jul 2026): https://caasols.github.io/roger-paulino/exhibitions/off-field/
- Scrolls (Buraco, Lisboa, 23 May - 4 Jul 2026): https://caasols.github.io/roger-paulino/exhibitions/scrolls/
- Welt am Draht (Rosalux, Berlin, February 2026): https://caasols.github.io/roger-paulino/exhibitions/welt-am-draht/
- Canto da Teia (andar de baixo, Lisboa, 15 Nov - 20 Dec 2025): https://caasols.github.io/roger-paulino/exhibitions/canto-da-teia/
- The World Smiles at Us (Galeria 111, Lisboa, 8 Nov 2025 - 3 Jan 2026): https://caasols.github.io/roger-paulino/exhibitions/the-world-smiles-at-us/
- Cabbage and the Plan of Things (Ar.Co, Antigo Mercado de Xabregas, Lisboa, 1 Jun - 15 Sep 2023): https://caasols.github.io/roger-paulino/exhibitions/cabbage/
